speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me exactly what this generalized rash looks like, when it started, and if your newborn has had any fever or difficulty feeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Ophthalmia (with disseminated rash). The mother's history of gonorrhea and the newborn's age are classic risk factors; I will now request Gram stain and culture of any discharge from the eyes to confirm the diagnosis.
